About the event

Build with structure.
Ship with confidence.

Kiro Rush is a practical, build-focused experience centered on using Kiro and AWS to move from an idea to a working software solution.

What is Kiro?

Kiro is an agentic AI development environment from AWS. Its spec-driven workflow helps developers move from requirements and design through implementation, testing, and documentation—while keeping people in control of every decision.

What is AWS?

Amazon Web Services is a comprehensive cloud platform for compute, storage, databases, security, AI, monitoring, and deployment—giving builders the infrastructure needed to ship real products.

The build journey

From an idea to a deployed solution

A disciplined, spec-driven workflow built for learning fast and shipping with confidence.

STEP 01

Idea

Define the problem, users, features, and expected outcome.

STEP 02

Plan

Use Kiro to structure requirements, design, and implementation tasks.

STEP 03

Build

Use Kiro's AI-assisted workflow to implement and test the solution.

STEP 04

Deploy

Use appropriate AWS services to host applications and infrastructure.

STEP 05

Improve

Test, debug, monitor, and iterate with human review throughout.
